IconTileRecords:
The 128 icon records of 4 tilemap words.

When: DrawInventoryIcon (the equipment and item pages) and ExpandMenuTileGroups in lib_menu_screen_setup.
Sees: the inventory icons.
Why: every icon is four tiles; a record per icon makes the draw routine one loop.
In: n/a (data): 8 bytes per record, index = item id and $7F: four words: top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right (BG2 tilemap entries).
Out: written to the BG2 page at $7F7800 + the icon's offset (and the next row, +$40).
Clobbers: n/a (data).
IrisFrames:
The 32 tile masks of the iris transition.

When: PlayTransitionIn and PlayTransitionOut, once per step of the iris (transition types $80 and up: the return trips).
Sees: a grid of squares over the whole screen that fills in and opens into holes again (frame $00 is solid, $1F empty; the same 8 x 8 mask in every cell of the BG3 page, not one circle).
Why: the iris is a tile whose shape changes every step; the shapes are data.
In: n/a (data): 16 bytes per frame (2 bits per pixel), offset ((2 x type + bit 4 of iris_frame) << 8) | ((iris_frame and $0F) << 4); the type's bit 7 drops out of the 8-bit add, so only these 512 bytes are used by the shipped game.
Out: the frame is written to VRAM word $4000 and the two sub-frames run.
Clobbers: n/a (data).
ItemPagePalette:
The item page palette: 256 bytes, colours 0-127.

When: LoadItemPagePalette, every time the item page is shown (DrawItemPage).
Sees: the item icons and page frame in their own colours.
Why: the icons need other colours than the equipment page.
In: n/a (data): 128 BGR555 words.
Out: copied to cgram_buffer (colours 0-127) with MVN.
Clobbers: n/a (data).
MenuBgPalette:
The menu palette: 256 bytes, colours 0-127.

When: LoadMenuPalette (OpenEquipmentMenu, RedrawEquipmentPage and lib_menu_screen_setup).
Sees: the menu colours on the next NMI upload.
Why: the CGRAM buffer is uploaded by the NMI, so loading the palette is a copy.
In: n/a (data): 128 BGR555 words.
Out: copied to cgram_buffer ($7F:0000).
Clobbers: n/a (data).
MenuSpellPalettes:
The spell palettes 11-15: 160 bytes.

When: RestoreSceneBgGfxAndPalette, after a menu or a scene load.
Sees: the field's spell and effect colours return after the menu.
Why: the menu overwrites part of the palette, so the field's colours are put back.
In: n/a (data): 80 BGR555 words.
Out: copied to cgram_buffer + $160.
Clobbers: n/a (data).
MenuTileGroupMap:
A 16 x 16 map of tile group numbers for the icon records.

When: ExpandMenuTileGroups (lib_menu_screen_setup), when it draws a block of icon tiles.
Sees: a block of icon tiles drawn in one pass.
Why: the group number selects the icon record (group x 8 into IconTileRecords).
In: n/a (data): 256 bytes, row-major.
Out: the group number of each cell.
Clobbers: n/a (data).
